role: Background task for periodic COMPUTES_TO edge confidence decay in knowledge graph
detail: Provides run_computes_to_decay() which scans all active COMPUTES_TO edges, recomputes confidence using ACT-R decay formula with BASE_PROCEDURAL (0.15) or BASE_GUARDIAN_CONFIRMED (0.60), and updates edges where confidence changed >0.001. DecayTaskResult dataclass tracks edges_scanned, edges_updated, edges_below_threshold (<0.50), and edges_marked_prunable (confidence <0.05, encounter_count <3, not guardian-confirmed). Guardian-confirmed edges never marked prunable but may decay below retrieval threshold. Important thresholds: RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD=0.50, pruning_eligible set when confidence <0.05, epsilon tolerance=0.001. Writes back to graph only when confidence changed or newly prunable.
gotchas: No deletion of below-threshold edges; guardian-confirmed edges retain status and not marked prunable even if decayed. Deprecated edges silently skipped in loop. Edge.confidence top-level field kept in sync with properties dict during save.
